header.running_head: 3. Belief in the Events after Death...

blocks.tamil_translation: ‘they are to be questioned! (The angels will be commanded that they be called to account for their deeds.) Then the order will be given, “Separate the people of Jahannam from among them!’ It will be asked, ‘How many out of how many?’ The reply will be given, “From every thousand people, nine hundred and ninety-nine (separate them out). The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, “That Day is the day that will make children old; the hardship and great length of that Day will turn even children into old men, though in reality the children do not grow old. And that Day is the day when the shin will be uncovered. On that Day this event will take place. On that Day Allah will manifest a special light.

blocks.text:
In another narration, on hearing the news, “Out of every thousand, 999 people will go to Jahannam,” the Sahabah were shaken. The colour of their faces changed. After that the Prophet ﷺ said, “The 999 people going to Jahannam are Ya'juj and Ma'juj and others like them who disbelieve in Allah and associate partners with Him; the one person out of each thousand (who goes to Jannah) is from among you (one who follows your way),” he said.
(Bukhari)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: كَيْفَ أَنْعَمُ وَصَاحِبُ الْقَرْنِ قَدِ الْتَقَمَ الْقَرْنَ وَاسْتَمَعَ اْلاَُذُنَ مَتَي يُؤْمَرُ بِالنَّفْخِ فَيَنْفُخُ فَكَأَنَّ ذلِكَ ثَقُلَ عَلَي أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَقَالَ لَهُمْ: قُولُوا: حَسْبُنَا اللهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ عَلَي اللهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي وقال: هذا حديث حسن باب ماجاء في شان الصور رقم:٢٤٣١
